source.caption:
Looking for things to do across Los Angeles? From Armenian harvest celebrations and creative upcycled art workshops to community parades honoring our nation's heroes, plenty is happening around L.A.!

🍂 Golden Autumn Festival (Voske Ashun)
Celebrate the harvest season and the rich traditions of Armenian culture with an afternoon centered on gratitude and togetherness. Enjoy live folk dancing, authentic food, local artisan vendors, and fun, family-friendly activities.
📅 Friday, November 6, 2026 | 3–7 PM
📍 Saticoy Elementary School, North Hollywood, CA
💲 Free (RSVP requested)
🔗 cd2.lacity.gov/calendar

🎨 Trash Art Party
Transform everyday household waste into artful treasure at this creative, hands-on collage workshop led by artist April Dyer Morton. Explore colors, textures, and found objects to reimagine what discarded materials can become.
📅 Saturday, November 7, 2026 | 2–4 PM
📍 West Los Angeles Library, 11360 Santa Monica Blvd., Los Angeles, CA 90025
💲 Free
🔗 lapl.org/events

🎖️ 23rd Annual San Fernando Valley Veterans Day Parade
Come together to show your appreciation and honor the courage, service, and sacrifice of our nation’s veterans. Line the boulevard with friends and family to salute local service members and marching groups in this proud Valley tradition.
📅 Wednesday, November 11, 2026 | 11 AM–1 PM (Parade begins at 11:11 AM)
📍 Laurel Canyon Blvd. (between San Fernando Mission Blvd. & Paxton St.), Los Angeles, CA
💲 Free
🔗 cd7.lacity.gov/events
